name: Earthfathers
text: After surviving damage, gain 2/3/4/5/6 strength

name: Chilled Stonedames
text: After surviving damage, destroy enemy units in front

name: Temple of Life
text: At the start of your turn, vitalize 1/2/2/3/3 friendly unit/units/units/units/units, then spawn a 1 strength copy of itself on the tile behind or in front, up to your furthest row

name: Glacier Palace
text: At the start of your turn, freeze the most forward enemy unit

name: Iceflakes
text: On play, freeze itself

name: Blizzard Bombs
text: On death, freeze surrounding units

name: Orgone Leechers
text: Before moving, lose 3 mana and freeze an enemy in the tile in front. Decrease the loss by 2 for each other friendly Ancient and Frostling

name: Crystalshields
text: Before moving, teleport to a random tile bordering your base. If successful, give 1/2/2/3/3 strength to your base
